title: PSA: GTA 6 Does Not Have Online Multiplayer at Launch
description: GTA 6 is less than a week away from its PS5 launch on November 19, 2026. Reports indicate that online multiplayer will arrive a little later.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Launch Nears: Online Multiplayer Arriving Later

We are now less than a week away from the official launch of *Grand Theft Auto 6*, with the game scheduled to arrive on PS5 on November 19, 2026. Excitement is at an absolute fever pitch across the global gaming community as the release window rapidly approaches.

However, a crucial detail to keep in mind comes via gaming outlet Push Square, which reports that **GTA 6 will not feature online multiplayer at launch**. Instead, the online component will arrive a little later down the line.

### Anticipation and Industry Context

Given the monumental legacy of *GTA 5*—which stands as the third best-selling video game of all time with a staggering 235 million copies sold—GTA 6 is widely expected to become the biggest entertainment launch in history. 

While some multiplayer enthusiasts might wish to dive straight into online lobbies on day one, staggering the release of the online component is a strategy reminiscent of past major releases, allowing players to initially immerse themselves fully in the foundational experience before the multiplayer ecosystem opens up.

## Editor's Take
Holding back online multiplayer for a slightly later release date ensures the launch focuses purely on the core experience. With the bar set impossibly high by GTA 5, giving players time to digest the initial release before expanding into the online space is a sensible and measured approach for what is poised to be the biggest entertainment event of the decade.
